source: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates

schema.rates_percent: mapping from maturity label to annual par yield in percentage points

selection: Selected the 3-month, 6-month and 1-year columns from the official 2024-12-02 row.
missing_values: No selected observation was missing; validation rejects absent or nonnumeric maturities.
transformations: Copied displayed percentage values without interpolation; downstream examples divide by 100 before using a rate.
scope_limit: Discount-input provenance demonstration only; not an option quote, volatility surface, trading signal, or current-rate feed.
